body:
Claim: PM loop round 8 · 2026-10-16T08:20Z · a vertical seam, in one PR, `Fixes #23842`. `FlowRuntimeState` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`) gains one optional, closed discriminator beside `reason`, named by the spec's conventions, that says WHY an enabled, triggered row is `bound: false`. It has one value per distinct cause the producer composes today; the card's example is `deployment_policy` vs `binding_failure`, and the dev measures the real set. `service-automation` stamps it at every site that composes `reason`. `reason` stays the rendered sentence, and its "⛔ do not parse it" rule stays true.
Session: `session_01HjR8RUwTPQ3TgbfKihmxp9` (the dispatching seat; the dev runs as a cloud session the seat post names)
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; this card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23842-flow-unbound-cause`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23842` (in the cloud session's container)
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#1` (seat post #6017)
File surface (at `origin/main` `3fed1eb00a` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`: `FlowRuntimeState` and its docblocks only, plus any exported union or constant the field needs.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`: the sites that compose `bound: false` with a `reason` (`getFlowRuntimeStates` and its helpers), and their tests in the same package.
- Any wire mirror of `FlowRuntimeState` the sweep finds (a zod response schema, the `/_status` route's shape, an api-surface baseline), through its generator where one exists.
- One `minor` changeset each for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/service-automation`.
- ⛔ Not `reason`'s text, not `ScheduledWorkPolicy` or `scheduledWorkDisabledReason`, and not objectui.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud` (the maintainer's word in this session's chat: 「batch 调到 5, 可以开云卡」), `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate). A widening of a published contract: the review owed before the queue is at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, face `packages/spec/src/contracts/**`.
Clause-②: yes
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card (filing gate ③, the maintainer's 「全部立卡」 via objectstack-ai/objectui#12609)
Thread-read: none
Ruling-ref: none (triage's split `6210398091` on objectstack-ai/objectui#12609, option B)
Serial constraints cleared:
- The file lists of all 20 open PRs and the latest `Claim:` of all 24 open `pm:dispatched` cards were read in this act. No open PR touches `contracts/automation-service.ts` or `service-automation/src/engine.ts`.
- #23802's claim (`domain:engine` seat 2) names `service-automation` only to exclude it from its scope.
- Cross-lane: `packages/services/service-automation` is `domain:services`. This seat posts a cross-seat declaration on that lane's live seat post in this act.
- Downstream: this card's claimant files the console half (the chip and the banner) on objectstack-ai/objectui once the field ships in a published `@objectstack/spec`.
